name: Early Tumblr reaction captions
description: A concentrated register of fragmented reactions, emotional nouns, and exaggerated captions in early Tumblr circulation.
cause_of_death: Contemporary parody and mainstream saturation eroded distinctiveness; the ending is an estimated register boundary.

sources.title: A sincere guide to Tumblr slang
sources.note: Contemporary guide expressly distinguishes its definitions from an earlier parody guide and documents pervasive expressions.

sources.title: I Can't Even
sources.note: Chronology includes a July 2010 Tumblr-specific definition and mainstream saturation in the early 2010s; page subsequently updated.

sources.title: Feels
sources.note: Chronology documents 2010 precursor and 2012 definitions, captions, and uptake.

sources.title: All the Things
sources.note: Dates the source comic to June 17, 2010 and remixes spreading in 2011.

entries.gloss: A fragmented declaration of being overwhelmed by admiration, surprise, or distress.

examples.text: You covered my shift; I can't even. Thank you.

entries.rationale: The 2012 guide attests this as pervasive Tumblr vernacular and records that the register already prompted parody. The signature represents that bounded expression cluster, not the birth or death of the platform. Onset and peak are estimates surrounding the attestation; fade is an estimated loss of novelty, not a measured last use. Older precursor constructions may exist.
